theme_strategy.description: A premium, calm, and intelligent dark mode UI. Deep navy/charcoal backgrounds create a moody, expensive feel, while vibrant teal/mint (#19E0B7) acts as a high-contrast kinetic trigger for core actions. Avoids the chaotic red/orange typical of food delivery apps to focus on an elevated dining experience.

font_family.heading: Outfit, system-ui, sans-serif
font_family.body: Plus Jakarta Sans, Inter, system-ui, sans-serif

button.primary: bg-[#19E0B7] text-[#042F26] font-bold rounded-full py-3 px-6 active:scale-95 transition-transform flex items-center justify-center
button.secondary: bg-slate-800 text-white font-semibold rounded-full py-3 px-6 active:scale-95 transition-transform border border-slate-700
button.ghost: bg-transparent text-[#19E0B7] font-semibold py-3 px-4 active:opacity-70

card.default: bg-slate-800/80 rounded-2xl p-4 border border-slate-700/50 shadow-lg
card.interactive: bg-slate-800/80 rounded-2xl p-4 border border-slate-700/50 shadow-lg active:bg-slate-700 transition-colors

chip.default: bg-slate-800 text-slate-300 px-3 py-1 rounded-full text-sm font-medium border border-slate-700
chip.active: bg-[#19E0B7]/10 text-[#19E0B7] px-3 py-1 rounded-full text-sm font-medium border border-[#19E0B7]/30

input.default: bg-slate-900 border border-slate-700 rounded-xl px-4 py-3 text-slate-100 placeholder-slate-500 focus:border-[#19E0B7] focus:ring-1 focus:ring-[#19E0B7]

bottom_navigation.container: bg-[#0B0F19]/90 border-t border-slate-800 pb-safe pt-2 px-6 flex justify-between items-center backdrop-blur-lg

icons.style: Stroke width 1.5, slightly rounded caps. Avoid filled icons except for active bottom nav states.

illustrations.empty_states: Use minimalist line-art illustrations accented with #19E0B7. e.g., A minimalist cloche for 'No orders yet', outline of a map pin for 'No restaurants found'.

accessibility_and_testing.contrast: Ensure all text on dark background meets APCA or WCAG AA standards. Soft grays must be legible. Off-white (#F8FAFC) is preferred over pure white.
accessibility_and_testing.touch_targets: All interactive elements (buttons, links, icons) must have a minimum hit area of 44x44px.
accessibility_and_testing.testing: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a `data-testid` attribute (kebab-case, role-based). Example: `data-testid="join-queue-button"`

customer.key_focus: Discovery, live tracking, and seamless pre-ordering.
customer.ui_elements: Wait-time chips with live pulsing animation (using #19E0B7 for fast, #F59E0B for medium, #EF4444 for long). Whatsapp-style notification cards for chat updates.

host.key_focus: High-density data view, quick actions, queue management.
host.ui_elements: Control-room grid layout. Actionable list rows with swipe-to-seat or swipe-to-remove actions. Bold, readable typography for party sizes and wait times.
